title: Geostationary Full-Disk Imagery
description: Full-disk Level 1b radiance and reflectance imagery from the GOES, Himawari, and GK-2A geostationary weather satellites, reformatted from public AWS archives into cloud-optimized Zarr/Icechunk arrays. The dataset provides full-Earth-disk observations spanning historical to near-real-time coverage.
